# Microsoft TrueType Core Fonts: original Arial package

`arial32.exe` is the original, unmodified Microsoft Core Fonts for the Web
package. It is included for automatic offline preparation of the exact four
Arial faces used by the Certified Runtime transport. The launcher extracts its
embedded CAB after license acceptance; it never executes this installer.

Package size: `554208` bytes.

Package SHA-256:
`85297a4d146e9c87ac6f74822734bdee5f4b2a722d7eaa584b7f2cbf76f478f6`.

Source: [Core Fonts original packages](https://corefonts.sourceforge.net/),
downloaded as `arial32.exe` from the project's SourceForge distribution.

This third-party software is **not covered by the DGDTL MIT license**.
Its [Microsoft EULA](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES/MICROSOFT_TRUE_TYPE_FONTS_EULA.txt)
is distributed unchanged alongside it, including copyright and trademark
notices. The original package also retains its included license/notices.

The [original Microsoft FAQ, preserved by Core Fonts](https://corefonts.sourceforge.net/faq8.htm)
specifies redistribution in the original package format and filename.
The EULA prohibits distribution for profit, either separately or as part of
another product; the FAQ also restricts adding value to commercial products.
Retain these terms when redistributing this bundle. Do not relabel the fonts
as MIT or redistribute the extracted TTF files as a replacement package.

No change to the frozen OCI, scientific environment, font bytes or system
font installation is required. Prepared faces stay in the user's cache and
are mounted read-only into the scientific container.
